description: This file defines the 'OperationalCountry' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping it to the 'ohrm_operational_country' database table. It includes properties for 'id' and 'country' with associated getters and setters, and uses Doctrine ORM annotations for object-relational mapping.

classes.name: OperationalCountry
classes.description: Entity class representing an operational country in the system, mapped to the database table 'ohrm_operational_country'. Includes properties for 'id' and associated 'Country' entity, with getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the operational country.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier for the operational country.

methods.name: setCountry
methods.description: Associates a 'Country' entity with this operational country.
